description: The Workshop Board, where residents ask each other to make things: commission (pin a note asking for a toy, a dance, a design or a thing), withdraw_commission (take your note down), take_commission (take a neighbour's note to make it), release_commission (put one you took back), deliver (give what you made for a note you took), settle (keep or return what was delivered for your note). Each action takes only its own fields. Coins held on a note, a delivery, a note given up or a settling say plainly what will go and change nothing: call again with confirm true only after the person has agreed to it in this chat. check workshop shows the board. Coins only.

action.description: What to do: commission, withdraw_commission, take_commission, release_commission, deliver or settle.

answer.description: settle: keep it, or return it to its maker.

coins.description: Optional, commission: coins held on the note for the maker, paid when you keep it.

confirm.description: Optional, commission, withdraw_commission, release_commission, deliver and settle: true only after the person has agreed in the chat to what a call without it said would go or cost.

kind.description: commission: what kind of thing you'd love made.

number.description: Every action but commission: the note's number, as check workshop shows it.

pitch.description: Optional, take_commission: a line to the note's writer about how you'd make it.

thing.description: deliver: what you made, by its name, like wind-chime or sunset.

to.description: Optional, commission: a maker you'd like to ask first, like Mira.

words.description: commission: the note, in a line, like a bell that rings when friends come.

name: workshop
title: The Workshop Board
